Container.Name: SelfMediaHub
Container.Overview:
Read-only analysis and overview layer for existing media libraries (Emby, Jellyfin, Plex). Not a media server - a smart view of what you already have. Reads movies and shows read-only into its own database and never writes back to the media server (optional exception: age ratings / FSK to Emby). Cover and configurable list view, filters by library, type and rating, completeness check, tags and rules, notifications. Sources are added in the web UI and stored encrypted.
DE: Read-only Analyse- und Übersichtsschicht für bestehende Mediatheken (Emby, Jellyfin, Plex). Kein Medienserver - eine intelligente Sicht auf das, was du schon hast.
Container.License: Proprietary - free for private self-hosting, see project LICENSE
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: emby jellyfin plex media library overview analysis fsk age rating tmdb
Container.Requires: An existing Emby, Jellyfin or Plex server (or local media folders). Sources are added in the web UI under Settings.

Config.Name: Data path
Config.Description: Path where SelfMediaHub stores its own database.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the SelfMediaHub web interface.

Config.Name: TMDb API Key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. themoviedb.org v3 API key. Needed for age-rating suggestions, genres and the completeness check. Empty = these features are off.

Config.Name: Scan interval (hours)
Config.Description: Background scan every N hours (0 = off).

Config.Name: Notification webhook (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Generic JSON webhook (Discord / ntfy / Apprise). Empty = off.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. IP(s) of your reverse proxy, comma-separated. Only then is its X-Forwarded-For header trusted for the login throttling. Leave empty without a proxy.

Config.Name: Cookie secure
Config.Description: 1 = always send the session cookie HTTPS-only. Default 0: detected automatically per request (HTTPS or X-Forwarded-Proto).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid default 99 = nobody). The container only starts as root to hand over the data folder.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid default 100 = users).

Config.Name: Allow Emby write (FSK)
Config.Description: 1 = SelfMediaHub may write the age rating (FSK) back to Emby. Default 0 (read-only).
